description_text:
Car Name: SHC MCE 78
This car is rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender file, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this car is calculated on it's combination of parts and options in relationship to other MCE cars.The lower priced MCE cars have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced MCE cars.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
This car is made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exterior
*Detailed interior (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engine (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed underside
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the exported files.
*The Studio, materials and camera/door animations are included in the Blender file that is used to create all realtime renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The car is royalty free, so you are free to modify and use it in any (commercial) project as much as you want.
*Objects: 46
File formats: (all file formats are exported with blender 2.8 default settings)*abc *blend *dae *fbx *obj *stl 
[Options]Car Body: Mid Size 2 door sedan
Engine: (Engine block can be removed to simulate an electric car, the mechanical parts under the hood will remain)V8
Sport pack:Yes (Rear wheels wider than front wheels, Wider body, Larger wheels, Larger engine with more cilinders, Upgraded hood, Larger brakes with red calipers, Added front and rear bumper lips and sideskirts, Flat bottom steering wheel)
Front bumper:Tier 6
Rear bumper:Tier 13
Dashboard:Tier 1
Exhaust:Tier 3
Wheels:Tier 1
Glass Roof:Yes
Seats:Sport Seats
Executive rear seats with table and screens:No
Trim Color:Matte black
Interior Leather Color:Brown
Tinted Rear Windows:Yes
Wheel Color:Grey

Wheel and tire of vintage soviet ZAZ automobile.
Model has two versions of tires - perfectly round for animation and slightly deflated for still images. Max version has both tires in one file, OBJ and FBX has each tire in separate file.

  - Modeled in 3ds max.

  - Model is scaled to proper real world dimensions. Scene units are in cm.

  - All objects and materials are properly and uniquely named.

  - All transformations has been reset and model is placed at scene origin [0, 0, 0 XYZ].

  - 
Important: rust on the wheel rim is added through Corona AO. You will need to re-create the effect on your own, if you want to use the model outside of 3ds Max and Corona.

  - Textures are collected in two arhives and are delivered in separate files. 

  - Render scene is not included.

Scene has 5 high quality PNG format textures in 2K resolution.
File formats available: MAX, FBX, OBJ
Please contact me if you have questions or need assistance with the models.

description_text:
Car key 3D Model. 3 individual objects (case, key, metal ring; so, you can easily rotate, open, close, or even animate them) sharing the same non overlapping UV Layout map, Material and PBR Textures set. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
3 Objects (meshes), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 27450 vertices, 27310 quad faces (54620 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
High-quality low-poly 3D model of British Phone Booth.
It is best for use in games and other VR / AR, real-time applications such as Unity or Unreal Engine.
It can also be rendered in Blender (ex Cycles) or Vray as the model is equipped with detailed textures.
Model is built with great attention to details and realistic proportions with the correct geometry,
this way it is also good enough for close-ups.  
Technical details:

  - 1024 x 1024 Diffuse and AO texture set

  - 2344 Triangles

  - 1112 Polygons

  - 1261 Vertices

  - Model is one mesh.

  - Solid and glass material are correctly assigned under different IDs.

  - Model completely unwrapped.

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied. 

  - Pivot point centered at world origin.

  - Model scaled to approximate real world size (centimeters).

  - All nodes, materials and textures are appropriately named.

Available file formats:

  - 3ds Max 2016 (.max)

  - Maya 2018.3 (.mb)

  - Blender 2.82 (.blend | Cycles)

  - Unity3d 2017.3 (.unitypackage)

  - USDZ/glTF 2.0 (.glb)

  - Autodesk FBX (.fbx)

  - 3D Studio (.3ds)

  - Collada (.dae)

  - OBJ (.obj)

description_text:
Six raised panel door 3D Model. 3 individual objects (frame, door, handle), sharing the same non overlapping UV Layout map, Material and PBR Textures set. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
3 Objects (meshes), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 22966 vertices, 22436 quad faces (44872 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
Real-Time,Game Ready, Retro Fire Alarm.
Display images were rendered in Marmoset Toolbag.
Normal maps were baked from a high poly model in Substance Painter. The Normal Maps are baked with the MikkT tangent space setting.
Includes the following 3d file types: (use the .fbx file to import into any popular 3d package)
Blender 2.90.1
.FBX
.OBJ
Marmoset 2 File - (the images you see in the thumbnails are using this file)
The textures are located in the .zip file. You will also find all the program files located in the .zip folder. We recommend downloading the .zip and opening up your desired 3d format from there, the texture paths should automatically hook up that way.
Includes the following PBR texture types (BOTH Metalness and Specular workflows, perfect for Unity, Cryengine and UE4):
4096x4096: Ambient_Occlusion 4096x4096: Normal Map
4096x4096: Diffuse 4096x4096: Gloss 4096x4096: Specular
4096x4096: Base Color 4096x4096: Roughness 4096x4096: Metalness
Source texture maps from the hi-poly bake are also included so you can re-texture if desired.
4096x4096: Ambient_Occlusion 4096x4096: Curvature 4096x4096: MeshNormals 4096x4096: Position 4096x4096: Thickness 4096x4096: World_Space_Normal
Note about textures. The Normal maps are -y, this is fine for directx. If they look flipped, just highlight the green channel in photoshop and hit ctrl+i.
If the roughness and metalness look too shiny in say, UE4, you'll have to make sure they are set to linear. Just double click the texture and uncheck the sRGB box. You can also fix that by combining maps in an image editor like Photoshop.
UV's are mostly flat with a few pieces overlapping where necessary.
Units are Metric.
Game Ready!
Please click on my Username for more Game-Ready models!

description_text:
Candle holder 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 12666 vertices, 12662 quad faces (25324 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
Parchment or paper scroll 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons), no poles.
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.79 (Cycles materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles for Blender 3D 2.7x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.79)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.79 with Cycles materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons), no poles; 20942 vertices, 20936 quad faces (41872 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height);so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.79 + Cycles using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
Roman amphora on stand 3D Model, nr. 2 in my collection. 2 objects (amphora, holder), each one with its own non overlapping UV Layout map, Material and PBR Textures set. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons), no poles.
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.79 (Cycles materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles for Blender 3D 2.7x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.79)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.79 with Cycles materials); other: png with Alpha.
2 Objects (meshes), 2 PBR Materials, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons), no poles; 21364 vertices, 21360 quad faces (42720 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height);so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.79 + Cycles using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

This asset includes 7 types of antic amphoras : 

  - Dressel 1B (Western Mediterranean, Middle and Northern Europe / wine)

  - Dressel 16 Gauloise (France & England / Fish)

  - Dressel 21 (Tyrrhenian coasts / Fruits)

  - Gallica 2 (Western Mediterranean / Wine)

  - Gallica 16 (Western Mediterranean / Wine)

  - Lyon Type 3 (South of France / Wine

  - Spatia (Africa, Mediterranean and continental Europe / Fish, Olive oil, Wine, Onions)

The collection includes 3 broken amphoras variants and also 3 pre-assembled assets with ropes. 
This assets of terracotta amphoras will embellish you scene and add more details which can help the gameplay and the game-design.
The material of models is unique and ready for PBR.
Low-poly model & Blender native 2.82
SPECIFICATIONS

  - Objects : 10

  - Polygons : 2452

  - Subdivision ready : Yes

  - Render engine : Eevee (Cycles ready)

GAME SPECS

  - LODs : Yes (inside FBX for Unity and FBX for Unreal only)

  - Numbers of LODs : 4

  - Collider : Yes (included only in the Blender file)

EXPORTED FORMATS

  - FBX

  - Collada

  - OBJ

TEXTURES

  - Materials in scene : 2

  - Textures sizes : 2K for amphora / 1K for rope

  - Textures types : Base Color, Metallic, Roughness, Normal (DirectX & OpenGL), Heigh and AO

  - Textures format : PNG

GENERAL

  - Real scale : Yes

  - Scene objects are organized by groups

ADDITIONAL NOTES
File formats do not include textures. All textures are in a specific folder named 'Textures'

description_text:
- concept model of the iPhone X / iPhone 8 that is expected to be released in September 2017

  - this phone doesn’t exist in real life, it’s based on rumours, speculations and ideas of the iPhone 8

  - high resolution model designed for presentation closeup, macro renders, animations, cgi

  - the model is neither real time nor game ready

  - model is subdivision ready

  - modeled in Cinema 4D and textured in Substance Painter so the textures are ready for Physically Based Rendering (PBR)

  - geometry is quad with cc.2% tris and no N-gons

  - unwrapped non-overlapping UV’s

  - UV textures are 4K (4096x4096)

  - 5 different colored versions included

  - 9 display textures included / UV mapped 4K texture and native 1402x2900 px display textures

  - all textures are .png

  - model has 3 objects : phone / glass / display

  - for C4D users the models are parented to Subdivision Surfaces / non .c4d users have the Sub Level 0 (native) and Sub Level 1 models

  - ready to render in Cinema 4D / render studio included for C4D and FBX (with C4D subdivision surface exported)

  - preview images rendered by C4D Physical renderer

  - every detail is built by geometry that’s why the higher vertex/polygon count | the mic and listener tiny nets have 185779 polygons which you can turn off if you don’t render those parts.The phone without these tiny elements have 23611 polygons / 29990 points

  - apple logo can be removed easily if you need a cool looking neutral phone (minimal UV repaint required to remove the iPhone backplate text also)

  - due to the nature of different 3D softwares and exchange formats, textures might need to be manually relinked or reassigned if you’re not using the .c4d file

FREE BONUS CONTENT:

  - photoshop .psd file included for the displays / you can freely add-remove icons change texts and background images

  - .c4d - native format

  - .fbx - v7.1 with sub 0 and sub 1 models without C4D subdivision surface 

  - .fbx - v7.1 with C4D subdivision surface exported

  - .dae - v1.5

  - .obj with .mtl

Phone without the Mic and Listener Micro NetPOINTS/VERTS : 29990POLYGONS : 23611
Phone with the Mic and Listener Micro NetPOINTS/VERTS : 284074POLYGONS : 215210

description_text:
Car Name: SHC MCE 77
This car is rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender file, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this car is calculated on it's combination of parts and options in relationship to other MCE cars.The lower priced MCE cars have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced MCE cars.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
This car is made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exterior
*Detailed interior (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engine (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed underside
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the exported files.
*The Studio, materials and camera/door animations are included in the Blender file that is used to create all realtime renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The car is royalty free, so you are free to modify and use it in any (commercial) project as much as you want.
*Objects: 53
File formats: (all file formats are exported with blender 2.8 default settings)*abc *blend *dae *fbx *obj *stl 
[Options]Car Body: Extended Wheelbase 4 door coupe
Engine: (Engine block can be removed to simulate an electric car, the mechanical parts under the hood will remain)V8
Sport pack:Yes (Rear wheels wider than front wheels, Wider body, Larger wheels, Larger engine with more cilinders, Upgraded hood, Larger brakes with red calipers, Added front and rear bumper lips and sideskirts, Flat bottom steering wheel)
Front bumper:Tier 12
Rear bumper:Tier 3
Dashboard:Tier 1 
Exhaust:Tier 3
Wheels:Tier 3
Glass Roof:No
Seats:Comfort Seats
Executive rear seats with table and screens:Yes
Trim Color:Matte chrome
Interior Leather Color:Black
Tinted Rear Windows:Yes
Wheel Color:Grey

description_text:
Artificial Soft Heart ** 3d printed prototype PBR modelReady to render : Corona Renderer Game Ready, PBR**High resolution texture :-Diffuse (4096x4096) -Reflect (4096x4096) -Normal map (4096x4096) -Glossy (4096x4096)Archive Include .obj and .fbx versions. 
The goal of the entirely soft artificial heart is to mimic its natural model as closely as possible. Currently, used blood pumps have many disadvantages: their mechanical parts are susceptible to complications while the patient lacks a physiological pulse, which is assumed to have some consequences for the patient. The developed heart beats almost like a human heart.
The soft artificial heart is created from silicone using a 3D-printing, lost-wax casting technique; it weighs 390 grams and has a volume of 679 cm3. It is a silicone monoblock with a complex inner structure. This artificial heart has a right and a left ventricle, just like a real human heart, though they are not separated by a septum but by an additional chamber. This chamber is in- and deflated by pressurized air and is required to pump fluid from the blood chambers, thus replacing the muscle contraction of the human heart.

Hello to everyone !!
I designed this project to participate in a competition. It was a project I made with pleasure, I hope you enjoy it too.You can contact me anytime :)

Historical InformationLong Cecil was instrumental in the successful defense of the world's richest diamond mines during the four-month siege of Kimberley by the Boers during the Anglo Boer War. Soon after the Boers laid siege of Kimberley, the British within the town realised that they needed a gun that could outrange and reply more effectively to the Boer artillery than the garrison's little mountain guns.
About the modelManufacture in stainless steel and brass, this is a very special piece of South African history. If you are ever fortunate enough to visit Kimberley, do pop in to Kimberley Club to view one of Zane's models proudly on display in the pub. description_text:
Musumeci Bridge - Ponte sul Basento
Il viadotto dell'industria sul fiume Basento[1], conosciuto anche come ponte sul Basento o ponte Musmeci[2], costituisce la connessione stradale tra l'uscita Potenza Centro sul raccordo autostradale Sicignano-Potenza e le principali vie di accesso nella zona sud di Potenza. Attraversa il fiume Basento, due linee ferroviarie (Battipaglia-Potenza-Metaponto e Altamura-Avigliano-Potenza) e tre strade principali della città, via della Fisica, viale Guglielmo Marconi e viale del Basento, congiungendosi con via Nicola Vaccaro nel tratto terminale.
«In alto, l'impalcato è una linea diritta e sottile, una piastra leggermente inclinata verso la città; sotto, curiose forme tridimensionali che ricordano le creste di un gallo ruspante o i copricapi delle suore ospedaliere in certi sogni di Federico Fellini, un guscio sottile che danza continuamente e nello stesso modo, sulla punta delle dita, a sostenere l'impalcato e appoggiare a terra, una membrana in cemento armato dello spessore di 30 centimetri, aumentato leggermente sui bordi, disegnata per esprimere sforzi uniformi e di sola compressione… Il ponte inoltre sembra superare la dicotomia tra il mondo superiore della carreggiata e quello dei luoghi sottostanti: è il 'sotto' a essere lo spazio qualificato dall'infrastruttura, che riprende la fluidità e l'organicità del corso d'acqua e della natura»

description_text:
Automobili Lamborghini S.p.A. (Italian pronunciation: [lamborˈɡiːni]) is an Italian brand and manufacturer of luxury sports cars and SUVs based in Sant'Agata Bolognese. The company is owned by the Volkswagen Group through its subsidiary Audi.
Ferruccio Lamborghini, an Italian manufacturing magnate, founded Automobili Ferruccio Lamborghini S.p.A. in 1963 to compete with established marques, including Ferrari. The company was noted for using a rear mid-engine, rear-wheel drive. Lamborghini grew rapidly during its first decade, but sales plunged in the wake of the 1973 worldwide financial downturn and the oil crisis. The firm's ownership changed three times after 1973, including a bankruptcy in 1978. American Chrysler Corporation took control of Lamborghini in 1987 and sold it to Malaysian investment group Mycom Setdco and Indonesian group V'Power Corporation in 1994. In 1998, Mycom Setdco and V'Power sold Lamborghini to the Volkswagen Group where it was placed under the control of the group's Audi division.
New products and model lines were introduced to the brand's portfolio and brought to the market and saw an increased productivity for the brand. In the late 2000s, during the worldwide financial crisis and the subsequent economic crisis, Lamborghini's sales saw a drop of nearly 50 percent.
Lamborghini currently produces the V12-powered Aventador and the V10-powered Huracán, along with the Urus SUV powered by a twin-turbo V8 engine. In addition, the company produces V12 engines for offshore powerboat racing. Lamborghini Trattori, founded in 1948 by Ferruccio Lamborghini, is headquartered in Pieve di Cento, Italy and continues to produce tractors.

description_text:
detailed, and clean model of an Atari 7800 pro system4K maps, clean quad-based topology, non-overlapping SUV
The Atari 7800 ProSystem, or simply the Atari 7800, is a home video game console officially released by Atari Corporation in 1986 as the successor to the Atari 2600 and Atari 5200. It can run almost all Atari 2600 cartridges, making it one of the first consoles with backward compatibility. It shipped with a different joystick model from the 2600-standard CX40 and included Pole Position II as the pack-in game. Most announced titles at the launch were ports of 1981–1983 arcade video games.
Designed by General Computer Corporation, the 7800 has significantly improved graphics hardware over Atari's previous consoles, but the same Television Interface Adaptor chip that launched with the 2600 in 1977 is used to generate audio. In an effort to prevent the flood of poor quality games that contributed to the video game crash of 1983, cartridges had to be digitally signed by Atari.
The Atari 7800 was first announced by Atari, Inc. on May 21, 1984, but a general release was shelved until May 1986 due to the sale of the company. Atari Corporation dropped support for the 7800, along with the 2600 and the Atari 8-bit computers, on January 1, 1992.

description_text:
Wine glasses 3D Model. 19 individual objects (madeira, port, sauternes, sherry, alsace, coupe, flute, hock, tulip, tumbler, burgundy, cabernet sauvignon, standard, sweet, large bourdeaux, pinot noir, red, white, chardonnay) sharing the same OVERLAPPING UV Layout map, Material and PBR Textures set. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
19 Objects (meshes), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 106976 vertices, 106938 quad faces (213876 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
In 2008, McLaren hired Frank Stephenson as design director for their reborn production car project.
As with the McLaren F1, carbon fibre is used extensively in the vehicle to minimise weight. The MP4-12C weighs 1,301 kg (2,868 lb) dry.
The chassis is based around a F1 style one-piece carbon fibre tub, called the Carbon MonoCell, weighing only 80 kg (176 lb). The MonoCell is made in a single pressing by using a set of patented processes, using Bi-Axial and Tri-Axial carbon fibre multiaxial fabrics produced by Formax UK Ltd. with the MonoCell manufactured by Carbo Tech in Salzburg, Austria.[10][11] This has reduced the time required to produce a MonoCell from 3,000 hours for the F1 and 500 hours for the Mercedes-Benz SLR McLaren, to 4 hours for the MP4-12C.
The car has a conventional two side-by-side seating arrangement, unlike its predecessor the McLaren F1 which featured an irregular three seat formation (front centre, two behind either side). To make up for this, however, the car's central console is narrower than in other cars, seating the driver closer to the centre. Interior trim and materials can be specified in asymmetric configuration – known as Driver Zone.

description_text:
Checkered racing flag 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons), no poles.
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.79 (Cycles materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles for Blender 3D 2.7x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.79)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.79 with Cycles materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons), no poles; 43744 vertices, 43692 quad faces (87384 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height);so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.79 + Cycles using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
|| Car Tire AAA PBR Game Ready Asset ||
Car Tire AAA PBR Game Ready Asset, is a high quality, low poly asset originally modeled in 3DS Max 2017.
The normal map was baked from a high poly model in Substance Painter 2020, making this product look very detailed without using many polygons. This product is intended for game/real time/ usage. This model is not intended for subdivision.
The renders and wireframes were done in Marmoset Toolbag 3. (The triangulation of the the mesh topology is caused by Marmoset).
||SPECS||
Low Poly Model:
All the main objects are separately and named correctly for an easy usage.
Includes: .obj, .max, .fbx, .3ds files.
.obj,.fbx and .3ds versions exported from 3ds Max 2017.
  - A color mask is included for the painted metal textures set, so the color can be changed easily.
An Unreal Engine 4 project is also included with textures. Ready to be used in your game.
An Unity package is also available.
Substance Painter workfile is inclued, for any changed if needed to the textures.
|| Geometry ||
Total :
2.385 Total Polys
2.346 Total Verts
4.740 Total Tris
Model unwrapped manually to make most efficient use of the UV space.
Model scaled to approximate real world size. All materials and objects named appropriately.
Tested in Marmoset Toolbag 3 (see renders).
No special plug-ins needed to use this product.
|| Textures ||
Textures for Unity 5 and Unreal Engine 4 can be downloaded.
Textures in .targa format:
2k texture set
PBR Textures (Basecolor, ambient occlusion, metallic, roughness, normal)
Unreal Textures (Basecolor,Normal, Occlusion/Roughness/Metallic)
Unity Textures (Albedo/Transparency, Metallic/Smoothness, Normal)

description_text:
A Formula One car is a single-seat, open-cockpit, open-wheel formula racing car with substantial front and rear wings, and an engine positioned behind the driver, intended to be used in competition at Formula One racing events. The regulations governing the cars are unique to the championship and specify that cars must be constructed by the racing teams themselves, though the design and manufacture can be outsourced.Modern-day Formula One cars are constructed from composites of carbon fibre and similar ultra-lightweight materials. The minimum weight permissible is 740 kg (1,631 lb). including the driver but not fuel. Cars are weighed with dry-weather tyres fitted.[3] Prior to the 2014 F1 season, cars often weighed in under this limit so teams added ballast in order to add weight to the car. The advantage of using ballast is that it can be placed anywhere in the car to provide ideal weight distribution. This can help lower the car's centre of gravity to improve stability and also allows the team to fine-tune the weight distribution of the car to suit individual circuits.FILE FORMAT:

description_text:
Volkswagen SP2 1973 - iconic brazilian sport car in PBR version and with interior
(The model is not 100% the same as the real one, but it takes a good eye to see the small differences between the 3D and the original).
The beautiful Volkswagen model was designed in 1969, it was the brand's first refrigerated model in the country. Although its aerodynamics and design were perfect for a sports model, it did not have great engine power. Still, it is one of the most iconic models in the auto industry worldwide.
Topology
The template has been separated into 3 parts to facilitate editing, including:

  - bodywork

  - wheels

  - interior

  - The bodywork has 2 materials, namely Glass and BodyMat

  - The wheels have a single material, as well as the interior of the vehicle.

  - The interior is well textured, has details that are said to be useful for your project.

details
1. Body + glass

  - verts: 19,294

  - polygons: 15,832

2. Wheels (four)

  - verts: 9,704

  - polygons: 8,096

3. Interior

  - verts: 5,984

  - polygons: 4,880

In total (all pieces)

  - verts: 34,982

  - polygons: 28.808

Textures
Textured in PBR with layers, all in 4096x4096 for each material already mentioned.

  - AO

  - BaseColor

  - Normal

  - Roughness

  - Metallic

  - Opacity (for the glass)

Renders: studio not includedBlender cycles (white studio)Iray (interior)
If you have any questions or requests, talk to me and I will answer you. Thanks for listening :)

Dating from Regency time period around 1810, this dark teak wood chest of drawers is full of beautiful charm and character.It has a rectangular moulded top above two graduating drawers with brass swan neck handles with decent floral design.The teak wood has aged to a dark reddish shade with a striking grain, good patina, and a traditional form of wax finishing.
This unique model is a wonderful eyecatcher in every architectural rendering, especially when combined with modern interior elements.
Real life approximate dimensions are:
Height 70cm/ 27.5 inches
Width:80cm / 31.5 inches
Depth:45cms / 18 inches
Clear model structure, UVs and proper naming
The model is designed to open each drawer individally. Each object is properly named and has clean, non overlapping UVs. The model is made of quad polygons and ready for subdivision (>98% quads, no poles).Modelled in real life scale, Z up.
2K, 4K and 8K PBR texture maps for wide range to close up renders
The model comes with three sizes of texture sets:

  - 8K diffuse, roughness, metallic and normal maps in png filetype

  - 4K diffuse, roughness, metallic and normal maps in png filetype

  - 2K diffuse, roughness, metallic and normal maps in png filetype

All textures are separately packed in a zip file

description_text:
Audi Quattro Matchbox around 1981
Matchbox is a popular toy brand that was introduced by Lesney Products in 1953 and is now owned by Mattel, Inc, which purchased the brand in 1997. The brand was given its name because the original die-cast Matchbox toys were sold in boxes similar to those in which matches were sold. The brand grew to encompass a broad range of toys, including larger-scale die-cast models, plastic model kits, slot car racing, and action figures.
During the 1980s, Matchbox began to switch to the more conventional plastic and cardboard blister packs that were used by other die-cast toy brands such as Hot Wheels. By the 2000s, the box-style packaging was re-introduced for the collectors' market, such as the 35th Anniversary of the Superfast series in 2004 and the 50th Anniversary of Superfast in 2019.
Products currently marketed under the Matchbox name include scale model plastic and die-cast vehicles, and toy garages.

Why Do you need to buy this Kit ?
I modeled and created these Seats to Impala 1967, but it's not 100 % similar to original one, so these seats can be use in any classic vehicle because is a very commun design and will add an air of simplicity in any composition of sort.

There are 3 ways to use it and one of these It's going to fits well in any game engine and real time renders because it's very low poly with good normals and nice topoligy, no ngons or trianguls that allows you to modifie preatty easy the mesh and the normals are fine and will be more easy to put modifiers such subdivision also. And only in the 3DSMax and Blender doc you already have crease on the edges to make easy to use OpenSubdivisions without the need to slide edges. So I creted 2 options of use for who works with reytrace renders or use in game engines with textures maps istead and all with 4K and 2K resolution that I baked and will brings the same qualitie with no subdivion and not only that, if you don't want to use subdivision I included High Poly mesh in the files.
( I just don't recommend to use the PBR textures in High Poly Meshe, because as you can see in the imagens both have diferent topology and there is not UV in the High Poly also.)
I separeted each model in diferent docs and the objects will have proper pivot points locations to make it easy and precise to put in any place.
Resume everything, you are going to buy It's a model that can be use and reused and It will fits in anything that you make it without trouble and saving thousands of time.
More Details

  - Comes with low poly and high Poly meshes, 6 Docs ( Blender and 3DSMax 2021/2018), 3 presets of PBR Textures and 4 materials in the doc files for each model

  - Clean topology and optimized geometry

I hope you enjoy and for any problems, wishs or questions just contact me in the comments.

description_text:
Sport Car Seat - Tesla Roadster
All preview images rendered with Octane Render. Plus a few screenshots of the model in the viewports of Cinema 4D, Substance Painter, and Element 3D. Enviroments and lighting setups are not included, but let me know if you want them.  You can find the complete car model in my store.
https://www.cgtrader.com/3d-models/car/sport/tesla-roadster-interior-3d-model
[Technical Information]

  - Real world scale.

  - All geometry is subdivision ready.
  - Polycount at subdiv Lv. 0: 2,476 (Base mesh).

  - Polycount at subdiv Lv. 1: 9,890 (As shown in the wireframes).

  - Polycount at subdiv Lv. 2: 39,560 (As rendered in Octane).

  - Fully unwrapped, non-overlapping UV's.

  - Polygon selections and Vertex Color tags for all sub-parts, so you can easily separate or re-shade specific parts.

  - 8K PBR Textures.

  - Normal maps are OpenGL, invert the green channel to convert to DirectX.

  - No N-gons, Isolated Vertices, or Complex Poles.

[Files Included]
_C4D_Octane - Cinema 4D project file with Octane shaders, using some of the 8K PBR textures, dedicated texture masks, and procedural shaders. This is where all the renders come from. Screnshot attached.
_ORBX - Octane Standalone Package with embeded textures. Can be unpacked as an OCS, or imported into any host program running Octane (or Standalone), using the orbx importer.
_SPP - Substance Painter project file. You can edit the PBR textures for all file formats bellow, and even re-export render engine specific versions (Vray, Unreal Engine, Unity, Reddshift, Corona, Arnold, and more). Screnshot attached.
_TEX - Textures exported from Substance Painter and used for all the files bellow. Textures are 4K 16bit png files (Spec/Gloss PBR). Unpack in the root folder. All files point to these textures by default. Screenshot attached.
_TEX_8K - Textures exported from Substance Painter and used for all the files bellow. Textures are 8K 16bit png files (Spec/Gloss PBR). You dont need to download the 8K textures if you dont need that much detail.
_C4D - Cinema 4D project file with Physical/Standard shaders using the PBR textures exported from Substance Painter. Screnshot attached.
_FBX - Autodesk FBX exported from C4D. You may need to re-tweak the shaders abit, depending on the program you open it in, but all PBR textures should maintain link.
_OBJ - OBJ/MTL exported from Cinema 4D. Three versions: subdiv Lv. 0 / 1 / 2. All PBR textures still applicable.
_E3D - Ready to use in Video Copilot's Element 3D, plus an After Effects project file with the model already loaded. Using the OBJ at subdiv Lv. 2, and the PBR textures. Swap the OBJ for any of the other subdivision versions to adjust polygonal detail (right click, replace model). You may need to re-link the model/textures upon opening it for the first time, so just point to the root folder, where you extracted the texture pack. Screnshot attached.
_MAX - 3ds Max project file with default shaders, using the PBR textures. May need adjustments.
Extra formats with embeded textures at various resolutions (Metal/Rough PBR): .dae (Collada), .usdz (Pixar/Apple AR), .gltf/.glb (Khronos Group).
All files are zipped.
If you have any questions or requests, dont hesitate to get in touch. Also please consider leaving a like or a comment discussing the model. Im eager to know what you think about my models, so i can find ways to improve.

description_text:
Car Name: SHC MCE 71
This car is rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender file, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this car is calculated on it's combination of parts and options in relationship to other MCE cars.The lower priced MCE cars have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced MCE cars.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
This car is made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exterior
*Detailed interior (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engine (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed underside
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the exported files.
*The Studio, materials and camera/door animations are included in the Blender file that is used to create all realtime renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The car is royalty free, so you are free to modify and use it in any (commercial) project as much as you want.
*Objects: 49
File formats: (all file formats are exported with blender 2.8 default settings)*abc *blend *dae *fbx *obj *stl 
[Options]Car Body: Extended Wheelbase 2 door coupe
Engine: (Engine block can be removed to simulate an electric car, the mechanical parts under the hood will remain)V12
Sport pack:Yes (Rear wheels wider than front wheels, Wider body, Larger wheels, Larger engine with more cilinders, Upgraded hood, Larger brakes with red calipers, Added front and rear bumper lips and sideskirts, Flat bottom steering wheel)
Front bumper:Tier 4

Wheels:Tier 3
Glass Roof:Yes
Seats:Comfort Seats
Executive rear seats with table and screens:Yes
Trim Color:Matte chrome

Wheel Color:Grey

High-quality low-poly 3D model of Old Style Gas Pump. It is best for use in games and other VR / AR, real-time applications such as Unity or Unreal Engine.
It can also be rendered in Blender (ex Cycles) or Vray as the model is equipped with detailed textures.
This way it is also good enough for close-ups. Model is built with great attention to details and realistic proportions with correct geometry. 
Technical details:

  - 2048 x 2048 Diffuse and AO textures

  - 2235 Triangles

  - 1190 Polygons

  - 1324 Vertices

  - Model is one mesh.

  - Model completely unwrapped.

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied. 

  - Pivot point centered at world origin.

  - Model scaled to approximate real world size (centimeters).

  - All nodes, materials and textures are appropriately named.

Available file formats:

  - 3ds Max 2016 (.max)

  - Maya 2018.3 (.mb)

  - Blender 2.82 (.blend | Cycles)

  - Unity3d 2017.3 (.unitypackage)

  - USDZ/glTF 2.0 (.glb)

  - Autodesk FBX (.fbx)

  - 3D Studio (.3ds)

  - Collada (.dae)

  - OBJ (.obj)

description_text:
High-quality low-poly 3D model of Parking Meter.
It is best for use in games and other VR / AR, real-time applications such as Unity or Unreal Engine.
It can also be rendered in Blender (ex Cycles) or Vray as the model is equipped with detailed textures.
The model is built with great attention to detail and realistic proportions with the correct geometry,
this way it is also good enough for close-ups.
Technical details:

  - 4096 x 4096 Diffuse and AO textures

  - 1302 Triangles

  - 527 Polygons

  - 683 Vertices

  - Model is completely unwrapped.

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied. 

  - Pivot points are correctly placed to suit the animation process.

  - Model scaled to approximate real-world size (centimeters).

  - All nodes, materials, and textures are appropriately named.

Available file formats:

  - 3ds Max 2016 (.max)

  - Maya 2018.3 (.mb)

  - Blender 2.82 (.blend | Cycles)

  - Unity3d 2017.3 (.unitypackage)

  - USDZ/glTF 2.0 (.glb)

  - Autodesk FBX (.fbx)

  - 3D Studio (.3ds)

  - Collada (.dae)

  - OBJ (.obj)

YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCCKuB8qTeRtiX0vye9qverw/

Additional Info:

  - To avoid misunderstandings this model is not intended for 3D printing.
It uses some low/mid-poly modeling tricks and is optimized for real-time and gaming apps and is an open mesh.
It is also intended primarily for rendering using various rendering engines (as Blender Cycles or Vray).

  - If you like this model and would like to make it printable please contact me first.
I'll try to make the model printable but I'll let you know if it is at all possible and what the differences will be.

  - If you are not sure about something in this 3D model then feel free to email me and ask before you buy.
I'll try try to reply as soon as possible and help you clear up any doubts. I can also send you some additional screenshots if you need.

description_text:
High-quality low-poly 3D model of Tall Street Clock.
It is best for use in games and other VR / AR, real-time applications such as Unity or Unreal Engine.
It can also be rendered in Blender (ex Cycles) or Vray as the model is equipped with detailed textures.
Model is built with great attention to detail and realistic proportions with the correct geometry,
this way it is also good enough for close-ups.  
Technical details:

  - 4096 x 4096 Diffuse and AO textures

  - 512 x 512 Diffuse and AO textures alpha

  - 2648 Triangles

  - 1249 Polygons

  - 1764 Vertices

  - Model is completely unwrapped.

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied. 

  - Pivot points are correctly placed to suit the animation process.

  - Model scaled to approximate real-world size (centimeters).

  - All nodes, materials, and textures are appropriately named.

Available file formats:

  - 3ds Max 2016 (.max)

  - Maya 2018.3 (.mb)

  - Blender 2.82 (.blend | Cycles)

  - Unity3d 2017.3 (.unitypackage)

  - USDZ/glTF 2.0 (.gltf)

  - Autodesk FBX (.fbx)

  - 3D Studio (.3ds)

  - Collada (.dae)

  - OBJ (.obj)

Additional Info:

  - To avoid misunderstandings this model is not intended for 3D printing.
It uses some low/mid-poly modeling tricks and is optimized for real-time and gaming apps and is an open mesh.
It is also intended primarily for rendering using various rendering engines (as Blender Cycles or Vray).

  - If you like this model and would like to make it printable please contact me first.
I'll try to make the model printable but I'll let you know if it is at all possible and what the differences will be.

  - If you are not sure about something in this 3D model then feel free to email me and ask before you buy.
I'll try try to reply as soon as possible and help you clear up any doubts. I can also send you some additional screenshots if you need.

description_text:
Low Poly Antique Raku Ceramic Urn 
The Stone Temple One Raku Urn - a unique Raku fired urn for your cherished cremation ashes.
What is Raku? Raku is a style of pottery, originating in Japan during the 16th century, that reflects Zen or Wabi-like properties, embracing austerity, brevity and tranquility. Using the western style Raku process, these cremation urns are removed from the kiln when the glazes have reached maturity. They are relocated to a reduction chamber and combined with combustible elm, alder, pine and oak tree shavings. This process brings out marvelous colors and textures. Each cremation urn is unique and unrepeatable, a perfect testimony for the cremated ashes of your loved one.
Modelled in Blender 2.77Textured in Substance Painter 2.0

description_text:
Description:  Lamp based on Japanese design made in teak wood
Model: Modeled in Maya 2018. Lowpoly model with 2162 tris available for games, also available the highpoly model.Hipoly model, used for baking purposes, can be found inside the .ma file Real world scale (1 unit = 1cm), 1 level of detail, unfolded and unwrapped UVs.Two Uv Maps embedded, second  Uv Map is for lightmap.

  - Unreal 4 (Metalness) packed RMA 4k TGA 8Bit { 3 maps: Base Color - Normal Map - Emissive Map - RMA } Tested in Engine, results like the marmorset preview

  - Unity 5 packed 4k TGA 8Bit {3 maps: Albedo - Normal Map - Metallic Smoothness } Not tested in engine.

  - Standard PBR Metalness 4k Tga 8 Bit { 6 maps: Albedo - Height Map - Ambient Occlusion - Metallic - Normal Map - Emissive Map - Roughness Map} 

The different Textures are separated in they respective RAR file
How to use RMA texture file:RMA stands for: Roughness, Metallic, Ambient Occlusion; Simply Connect: Red Channel to Roughness, Green Channel to Metallic and Blue Channel to Ambient OcclusionWhen Imported inside Unreal, remember to remove the sRGB tick, because Roughness, Metallic and Ambient Occlusion are linear maps and should be threated as such.
Why RMA: Packed files reduces memory space used.

description_text: “The Creation of Adam” is one of the most outstanding compositions of the Sistine Chapel. In infinite space God the Father flies surrounded by wingless angels, with a fluttering white tunic. The right hand is extended towards Adam’s hand and almost touches it. The body of Adam lying on a green rock gradually begins to move, awakens to life. The whole composition is concentrated on a gesture of two hands. The hand of God gives an impulse, and the hand of Adam receives it, giving the whole body vital energy. By the fact that their hands do not touch, Michelangelo emphasized the impossibility of combining the divine and the human. In the image of God, as conceived by the artist, not a miraculous beginning prevails, but a gigantic creative energy. In the image of Adam, Michelangelo celebrates the strength and beauty of the human body. In fact, it is not the creation of man that appears before us, but the moment at which he receives his soul, the passionate search for the divine, the thirst for knowledge.

Doric temple. Free interpretation based on the drawings of Canina L. (1834) of the Temple of Hephaestus (Athens, Greece).
The Doric order originated on the mainland and on western Greece. It is the simplest of the three orders of classical architecture, characterized by short, faceted, heavy columns with plain, round capitals on tops and no base.
Made in Blender:

  - blend native file

  - blend file with packed textures

  - obj/mtl

  - fbx

  - stl (waterproof, not tested for printing)

  - zip textures folder

One or more textures bundled with this project have been created with images from Textures.com. Please visit www.textures.com for more information.
Likes and positive review are very much appreciated. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact  me.

description_text:
Car Name: SHC MCE 68
This car is rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender file, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this car is calculated on it's combination of parts and options in relationship to other MCE cars.The lower priced MCE cars have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced MCE cars.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
This car is made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exterior
*Detailed interior (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engine (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed underside
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the exported files.
*The Studio, materials and camera/door animations are included in the Blender file that is used to create all realtime renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The car is royalty free, so you are free to modify and use it in any (commercial) project as much as you want.
*Objects: 46
File formats: (all file formats are exported with blender 2.8 default settings)*abc *blend *dae *fbx *obj *stl

Wheels:Tier 1

Double liquid concept bottle.
An easily stored bottle that can contain two liquids at once, not very ergonomic but it doesnt matter that much in space!
It includes the native .blend scene and an universal one, fbx obj and glb formats, the materials awere node based and are included in the native file, the exchange format have their parts separated by material but there are not normal and color textures included since i dont thinkl they are needed, however i included the rough map so it can look like in the thum nail in any pbr system.

description_text: The files introduce a revolutionary design for an unmanned aerial vehicle provided by a missile for aerial targets. The drone has a propeller for propulsion which can be driven electrically by electric motors. That design can be integrated with solar cells at the area of the wing span and the support which is provided to hold the vertical stabilizers. The wing span is  7.843 m and the backward support span is 5.968m. The total surface area of the vehicle is 63.42 m^2. The design was made in such a way that the propeller sucked the air layer on the upper and lower surface of the vehicle so that it will provide damping for any vortices with its function of propulsion. No material was applied to the vehicle but it’s easy to apply the required material from the Solidworks options according to your requirement. The missile was designed with a converging-diverging nozzle and sharp cone for adopting the supersonic flow properties. Note that for manufacturing, the aerodynamicists need to calculate the required load according to the material's density and the weight of the motors to get the location of the center of gravity and compare it with the aerodynamic loads- forces and moments- for gaining stability and smooth operation for the desired conditions like the required height and speed. That design represents a primary idea for innovation and combining sustainability with military aircraft for long-duration operations. I also provided a small forward canard to adjust the pressure distribution with the center of gravity for control and stability. The vehicle was designed as only one part( There is no assembled parts). and it is presented in solidworks file SDTL. and STL file

The rigging system allows for extensive pose and animation adjustments, making it easy to integrate the model into various projects. Customize the lighting and camera settings to achieve the desired visual effect. This Model has been created by taking inspiration and following the tutorial of polyjford. description_text:
Included 3d .blend model and fbx file with cycles materials.
The ZAZ-969 was a Soviet four-wheel drive automobile built by the Zaporizhia Automobile Building Plant (Ukrainian: ЗАЗ, Запорізький автомобілебудівельний завод, Zaporiz'kyi avtomobilebudivnyi zavod or Zaporiz'kyi avtozavod, ZAZ).[1] The first Soviet vehicle with front wheel drive, it was based on the LuAZ-967.[1]
Developing ideas from the unbuilt Moskvitch 415 prototype, designers used the LuAZ-967 as a basis for a four-wheel drive. vehicle[1] They added a body to the LuAZ's bare form, and fitted a 30 hp (22 kW; 30 PS) 887 cc (54.1 cu in) MeMZ 966 air-cooled four-cylinder engine.[1] No other mechanical changes were made.[1]
A pre-production batch of fifty was created in 1965, dubbed ZAZ-969, and production was authorized in 1966 as the 969V.[1] It was built by ZAZ until 1971, when LuAZ took over.[1]
Its pioneering (for a Soviet car) front wheel drive was due to a lack of drivable rear axles from the supplier, which was giving priority to the LuAZ-967.[2] Nevertheless, the 969 performed well, with a weight of only 1,340 kg (2,950 lb) (thanks in part to a soft top) and an 1,800 mm (71 in) wheelbase.[3] The transmission was a four-speed.[3]
When LuAZ took over production (making it the LuAZ-969), four-wheel drive became standard.[3]
In 1975, the LuAZ-969A replaced the original 969, offering a new 40 hp (30 kW; 41 PS) 1,197 cc (73.0 cu in) MeMZ 969 four-cylinder engine.[3] It survived until 1979.[3]
This was followed by a hard-top panel van version in 1977, known as the 969F, with a 400 kg (880 lb) payload, which was only built in small quantities.[3]
LuAZ began developing a replacement for the 969A in 1974, the 969M; it entered production in 1979.[3] It was named Volin, for the region around Lutsk (where the factory was located).[3] It retained the 40 hp (30 kW; 41 PS) engine, but changed to disk brakes with servo assist.[3] Door locks were added.[3] Folding windshield was standard.[3]
Luaz 969Exports were limited, though it proved popular in Italy, where Martorelli also offered it with a Ford engine.[3]

The Mercedes-Benz G-Class, sometimes colloquially called the G-Wagen (as an abbreviation of Geländewagen) is a four-wheel drive automobile manufactured by Magna Steyr (formerly Steyr-Daimler-Puch) in Austria and sold by Mercedes-Benz. Mercedes Brabus G Class Originally developed as a military off-roader, later more luxurious models were added to the line. In certain markets, it has been sold under the Puch name as Puch G until 2000. The G-Wagon is characterised by its boxy styling and body-on-frame construction. It uses three fully locking differentials, one of the few passenger car vehicles to have such a feature Mercedes Brabus G Class. Despite the introduction of an intended replacement, the unibody SUV Mercedes-Benz GL-Class in 2006, the G-Class is still in production and is one of the longest-produced vehicles in Daimler's history, with a span of 43 years. Only the Unimog surpasses it. In 2018, Mercedes-Benz launched a technically new second generation, still with only minor design changes. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercedes-Benz_G-Class

The mid-engine sport car - Bugatti EB110 3D print model
The Bugatti EB110 was unveiled on September 1991 exactly 110 years after Ettore Bugatti's birth.
In 1992, a lighter and more powerful model with 600 PS called the EB 110 SS (Super Sport) was introduced. The Super Sport could attain a top speed of 216 mph (348 km/h) and could accelerate from 0–62 mph (0–100 km/h) in 3.2 seconds.
SCALEAt 100% scale the car dimension are:Width approx. 408 mm (16 inches)Length approx. 892 mm (35 inches)Height approx. 222 mm (8.7 inches)
PRINTER SETTINGSAs the helmet is quite big, it is meant to be post-processed. We recommend a layer height of 0.1 to 0.3 mm on FDM printers. All parts are aligned to the printing platform for easy manipulation. Most of the parts need minimal or no use of printing supports to save printing time and filament. For reliable printing, we also recommend setting a brim to the helmets shell parts, because of their height and low thickness. It will ensure, that the parts will not come off the printing platform during the printing process. Printing settings will vary greatly depending on your specific printer.
Do you like the model and don't have a 3D printer? There are lots of people who offer 3D printing services these days. Try searching for someone who offers them in your area.

description_text:
Realistic, detailed Rotiform ZMO R19/215 wheel.
Modeled in Blender 2.92, rendered with Cycles.The files include:
8k textures:Diffuse/Roughness/Metalness/NormalThe main textures that give this look are roughness and normal, this means that you can use any color of your choice in combination with these textures and achieve this look. RotiformZMO_cap_diffuse texture can also be used as a mask for the logo when you are using your own shaders.
3 materials: (2 metal shaders and 1 glossy plastic shader) that are highly adjustable and can be easily used in any of your future renders that require these materials.
Every object, material, and texture is named. Objects have the correct scale and are UV unwrapped. Model uses crease based subdivision to save on vertex count and achieve cleaner geometry.
Subdivision level 1vertices: 27780 faces: 27780Subdivision level 2 vertices 107238 faces: 107238
No plug-ins were used.Hdri, light setup and background are not included.If you have questions, feel free to message me.

description_text:
This Motorcycle Helmet  Package  is based on the Bell Motorcycle Helmet headwear that can be seen on the upscale motorcycle enthusiasts. The helmet is perfect for men and women.  This asset is perfect for leisure time characters or 3D printing enthusiasts.Our Motorcycle Helmet  Package is fully customizable. The template included in the package allows you to add your own custom color options. It was designed for a standard height figures (186 cm) in Cinema 4D and Zbrush. This package is ideal for game assets, illustration and animation. It’s sized for standard figures in Unity, Poser or Daz Studio. I’ve broken the model down into its basic components for ease of customization. This Bike Helmet Package can be used in a variety of programs. I’ve included the file formats:

  - 3DS

  - DFX

  - OBJ (medium, high)

  - FBX 

  - Max

  - Blend

  - STL

  - ZTL 

  - C4D

  - 3D COATThe package offers textures and two obj files. The mesh comes in high and medium polygon options to fit your needs. The Blender version and the Cinema 4D version allow for mesh smoothing. Textures are included in 2048x2048 for clear resolution. The package includes the following maps:

  - Diffuse

  - Normal

  - Fresnel

  - Reflectance

  - RoughnessThe package is presented in zip format. This requires an unzipping tool which most computers have as standard application. Use the appropriate format into your favorite 3D modeling program and customize the textures. The TEX folder contains the textures that come with these models.The Motorcycle Helmet  Package  models come pre-UV mapped along with a handy bitmap template from which to layout your own textures. Feel free to drop your suggestions to me for both realistic and fantasy style headgear.Be sure to check out the other models in my gallery. I’m always adding more models, so check back regularly; just click on my user name.

description_text: When the riot police were founded in Berlin in 1952, the first VW convertibles were introduced. Used as a driver's vehicle, around 200 VW Beetle convertibles were in service until 1962. This VW was not only used by the riot police, but also in the traffic service from the mid-1950s.At that time, the traffic service in Berlin was part of the traffic relay in the area of ​​the police groups North, West and South. Each traffic relay had one of these vehicles for use as a lead vehicle. In addition to monitoring the flow of traffic, this vehicle was used to accompany state guests (escorts).The last of these VW convertibles was registered on August 14, 1968 and handed over to the West traffic relay in Berlin-Charlottenburg.It is not a muscle man, but at the time it was a robust vehicle with its displacement of 1192 liters, 34 hp and a top speed of 115 km / h.
